desc_ko: Jinhai Medical Technology Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company and its operating subsidiaries are engaged in provision of manpower outsourcing and ancillary services, dormitory services, information technology (IT) services, construction ancillary services for the building and construction industry, and minimally invasive surgery solution and medical products and related services. Its geographical markets include Singapore and the People's Republic of China. It provides integrated solutions provider from manpower resources to space management.
